name: @hyperbet/monorepo

scripts.build: bun run build:solana && bun run ci:scope:solana
scripts.test:launch:solana: turbo run test --filter=hyperbet-solana-app --filter=hyperbet-solana-keeper --filter=@hyperbet/sdk --filter=@hyperbet/ui && bun run --cwd packages/hyperbet-solana/anchor test
scripts.lint:solana: turbo run lint --filter=hyperbet-solana-app... --filter=hyperbet-solana-keeper --filter=@hyperbet/sdk && bun run ci:scenarios:solana:policy
scripts.typecheck:solana: turbo run typecheck --filter=hyperbet-solana-app... --filter=hyperbet-solana-keeper --filter=@hyperbet/sdk && (cd packages/hyperbet-solana/anchor && ./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tests.json) && tsc --noEmit -p packages/simulation-dashboard/tsconfig.solana.json
